description: ## Content Types The API supports responses in both XML and JSON

plexctl_base_url.title: PLEXCTL_BASE_URL
plexctl_base_url.description: Optional. Sets PLEXCTL_BASE_URL for the Plex Media Server MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

plexctl_identifier.title: PLEXCTL_IDENTIFIER
plexctl_identifier.description: Sets PLEXCTL_IDENTIFIER for the endpoint template variable {identifier}.

plexctl_port.title: PLEXCTL_PORT
plexctl_port.description: Sets PLEXCTL_PORT for the endpoint template variable {port}.

plexctl_user_agent.title: PLEXCTL_USER_AGENT
plexctl_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets PLEXCTL_USER_AGENT for the Plex Media Server MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

plexctl_user_token.title: PLEXCTL_USER_TOKEN
plexctl_user_token.description: Sets PLEXCTL_USER_TOKEN for the Plex Media Server MCP server. Get a credential from https://...`.
